description: SustainGym is Christopher Yeh and collaborators' Python suite of reinforcement-learning environments for sustainable energy systems. It includes electric-vehicle charging, electricity-market, data-centre, cogeneration and building environments, with single-agent Gymnasium and multi-agent PettingZoo interfaces. Inputs are environment configuration, scenario data and control actions; outputs include observations, rewards and evaluation results. Coverage and temporal detail vary by environment, not a single geographic deployment. Public source and documentation are free under CC-BY-4.0. A limitation is that physical constraints, distribution shifts and each environment's model assumptions affect comparisons; benchmark success does not establish safe or effective real-world control. Users must inspect environment-specific data and dependencies. SustainGym can compare operational policies across electricity and dependent infrastructure simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa) for planning. The repository cites its 2023 NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks paper and links environment guides. No training run, source dataset or pretrained policy was downloaded.
